name: AgentConnections
label: Agent connections
description: The agents connected to an account, each with its person, what it may do and when it last acted, and a Disconnect that cuts it off.

props.name: agents
props.description: The connected agents, in the order they are listed.

props.name: onDisconnect
props.description: Called by an agent's Disconnect. The host cuts its access at once, then sets its `status` to `disconnected`. Unset, the rows offer no Disconnect.

props.name: ownerLabel
props.description: The line under the agent's name naming its person, given their name: "For Sara Ito".

props.name: disconnectLabel
props.description: The Disconnect button's words. Defaults to "Disconnect".

props.name: disconnectAccessibleLabel
props.description: The Disconnect button's accessible name, given the agent's name, so a list of them is told apart. Defaults to "Disconnect Ledger".

props.name: disconnectedLabel
props.description: The mark a disconnected agent carries. Defaults to "Disconnected".

props.name: disconnectedAnnouncement
props.description: What is announced when an agent is disconnected, given its name. Defaults to "Ledger disconnected".

AgentConnection.description: One agent connected to an account.
